notes.title: Regular Update v1.08: New X-Ray Gameplay, Characters, Bug Fixes & More!
notes.content: [h1]Regular Update v1.08: New X-Ray Gameplay, Characters, Bug Fixes & More![/h1][p][/p][p]Dear Doctors,[/p][p]This update brings a major step forward for [i]Doctor Life Simulator[/i], with deeper gameplay systems, visual upgrades, interface improvements, and fresh content to explore. From immersive X-Ray scanning to a refined decision-making system, Version 8 sets the stage for what’s coming next  and it’s only the beginning.[/p][p][/p][h2]What is new at Version 8?[/h2][p][/p][h3]Enhanced Decision-Making System[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/6f8aa745cfc30fc5f47d785e7be41011eb772e71.gif"][/img][/p][p]In this update, we've improved how your choices shape the life of your doctor. Every decision, from diagnosis and treatment to ethical dilemmas and personal development, now has deeper consequences and branching outcomes.[/p][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Outcomes[/b]: Your decisions now influence patient satisfaction, hospital reputation, and your story.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ethical Scenarios[/b]: You'll face tougher moral choices with no obvious right answer. Will you put the patient first, protect the hospital, or look out for yourself?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Replayability Boost[/b]: Key events now have multiple outcomes, making each playthrough feel unique based on the choices you make.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New X-Ray Gameplay[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/63a56877d730c7588a5e8c3da2ca340ca28fad28.gif"][/img][/h3][p]Say hello to a brand-new interactive X-Ray scanning system! Designed to bring more immersion and precision to your diagnostic process, this feature puts you directly in control.[/p][list][*][p][b]Adjustable Parameters[/b]: Fine-tune Power, Exposure, Zoom, and Position to get the clearest image. Use the interface to locate fractures, tumors, or foreign objects in real time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interactive Feedback[/b]: You'll see the scan dynamically update as you adjust the sliders. The better your scan quality, the more accurate your diagnosis.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill-Based Imaging[/b]: Successful scans now depend on your attention and technical skills. Learn to master the tool or risk misdiagnosing your patients.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Characters & Character Graphics Overhaul[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/c05ecffad09d2a53b03174c75e1025735b94f688.gif"][/img][/p][p]Your hospital just got a lot more lively. We've introduced new faces and upgraded the look of existing ones to bring more personality and realism to your world.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Staff & Patients[/b]: Meet fresh characters with unique backgrounds, appearances, and dialogue. From quirky interns to demanding specialists, every new addition brings variety to your day-to-day interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics Refresh[/b]: Existing characters have received a visual upgrade. Improved models, more expressive animations, and refined textures make interactions feel more human and immersive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Diversity Boost[/b]: Expect a wider range of styles, ages, and looks among both staff and patients, helping to reflect a more authentic hospital environment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Version 1.08 Changelog[/h2][p][b]Gameplay Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced Decision-Making System[/p][/*][*][p]New X-Ray Gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Car Gameplay is Now Optional[/p][/*][*][p]Game Economy Updated[/p][/*][*][p]8 New Characters[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual and Audio Enhancements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lighting Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New Music Tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Main Menu Background Changed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Player Camera and Movement[/p][/*][*][p]Car Camera Angle Changed[/p][/*][/list][p][b]User Interface Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Furnitures UI[/p][/*][*][p]New Upgrades UI[/p][/*][*][p]NPC Mini-Avatars for Diagnosis Section Implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Added More Resolution Options[/p][/*][*][p]Localization Updates[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Harlequin removed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What’s Next?[/h2][p]We’re just getting started. Here’s a preview of what’s coming in future updates:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hospital Editor[/b]: Design and customize your own hospital layout. Build, expand, and organize departments exactly how you want.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Narrative-Driven Emergency Missions[/b]: Head into Brightwater City to take on high-stakes, story-rich emergency scenarios where your decisions can save lives.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Surgery Update[/b]: A full overhaul of the surgery system is on the way, featuring new procedures, tools, and interactive mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Co-op Gameplay[/b]: Work together with friends to run a hospital. Share responsibilities, coordinate care, and handle complex cases as a team.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mod Support[/b]: Create and share your own content, from custom characters to entire storylines, using upcoming modding tools.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][i]Our aim is to bring real medical gameplay to life.. with our community.[/i][/h3][h3][i]Don't forget to join our discord, we listen to your ideas and feedback.[/i][/h3][h3][i]Thank you for supporting us, doctors...[/i][/h3][p][/p][h3][i]-Blackburne Games Team[/i][/h3][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Day 4 Update - Bugfix
notes.content:
[p][b]📢 Doctor Life Simulator - Bugfix![/b]

Hello, Doctors!  

We’ve rolled out an exciting update for [b]Doctor Life Simulator[/b], featuring gameplay enhancements, new features, and bug fixes. Your feedback has been invaluable—thank you for helping us improve the game!  



[b]Gameplay Updates[/b]  
- Fixed and improved ambulance gameplay mechanics.  
- Car and house level updates for a smoother experience.  
- Refined level end UI and gameplay flow for a more rewarding conclusion.  
- New endings added for a richer story experience!  



[b]Audio and Visual Enhancements[/b]  
- Fixed issues with master volume and menu music/mute toggles.  
- Added motion blur settings and other graphic options for better customization.  
- New music tracks to elevate the atmosphere.  


[b]UI & System Improvements[/b]  
- Updated menu hover fonts for better readability.  
- Introduced a new staff hiring UI to streamline team management.  
- Enhanced home laptop functionality for in-game interactions.  
- Fixed language toggle and added localizations for a global experience.  



[b]Additional Fixes[/b]  
- Adjusted Stateschopu mechanic for improved balance.  
- Improved money and reputation tracking for better progression clarity.  


[b]Coming Soon: New Content![/b]  
This week, we’re bringing exciting new additions to [b]Doctor Life Simulator[/b]:  
- New patients with unique cases and challenges.  
- Furniture upgrades to customize your clinic.  
- Clinic upgrades to enhance gameplay and functionality.  



We’re dedicated to making [b]Doctor Life Simulator[/b] the best it can be, and we hope you enjoy these updates. Don’t forget to share your thoughts—we’d love to hear from you!  

[b]Update your game now and get ready for the upcoming content![/b]  

[img src="STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/4486ed9e99ef1bde68837f36ce8675d5a93dd554.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Day 1 Update
notes.content:
🩺 Doctor Life Simulator – Day 1 Update 🩺

Hello, Doctors!

Thank you for stepping into the world of [i]Doctor Life Simulator[/i]. Your feedback has been incredible, and we’re excited to bring you the Day 1 Update! This patch focuses on resolving key issues and adding new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

[h1]🛠️ Patch Notes 🛠️[/h1]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Turkish dubbing and localization bugs.
[*] Fixed alert & notification bugs.
[*] Fixed empty database issues.
[*] Resolved unreadable notification bug.
[*] Fixed Exit button functionality.
[*] Fixed the tutorial not starting properly.
[*] Fixed save system bugs to ensure progress is retained.
[/list]

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial for furniture editing to help new players get started.
[*] Added notifications for insufficient balance during purchases.
[*] Added new icons for the in-game computer interface.
[*] Introduced money and reputation tracking directly to the HUD for easier management.
[*] Added localizations for the following languages:
[list]
[*] 🇬🇧 English
[*] 🇨🇳 Chinese
[*] 🇫🇷 French
[*] 🇩🇪 German
[*] 🇪🇸 Spanish
[*] 🇮🇹 Italian
[*] 🇯🇵 Japanese
[*] 🇰🇷 Korean
[*] 🇷🇺 Russian
[*] 🇹🇷 Turkish
[*] 🇬🇷 Greek
[*] 🇬🇪 Georgian
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]🎉 Thank You! 🎉[/h1]
We are committed to delivering the best possible experience, and your input is invaluable. Please continue to share your thoughts in the community hub and let us know what you’d like to see next in [i]Doctor Life Simulator[/i].

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep saving lives in Brightwater City! 🏙️

[b]– The Blackburne Games Team[/b]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GoBR2Yqn6Ko;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Welcome to Doctor Life Simulator – Early Access[/h1]

Our goal is to create an immersive simulation of a doctor's life.

In this early access version, you can:
[list]
[*] Upgrade your hospital and unlock new missions
[*] Design and furnish your hospital
[*] Hire staff and manage your team
[*] Buy and collect vehicles
[/list]

This is just the beginning.

We’re working on expanding the open world of Brightwater City with:
[list]
[*] New missions and random events
[*] Home ownership and customization
[*] Relationship systems and life simulation features
[*] Surgeries, dentistry, and more detailed medical gameplay
[/list]

We’re committed to [b]weekly updates[/b] and building this game [i]with you[/i], the community.

Thanks for joining us early — let’s shape the future of Doctor Life Simulator together!

– The Doctor Life Simulator Team

notes.title: Early Access release date to May 30, 2025
notes.content:
We know we’ve kept you waiting, and we sincerely apologize for the two delays. But this was the reason: we wanted to make the experience accessible and meaningful for more people around the world.

We’re incredibly excited to share some big news with you!

To make Doctor Life Simulator accessible to a wider global audience, we’ve added full language support in the following languages:

🇬🇧 English
🇨🇳 Chinese
🇫🇷 French
🇩🇪 German
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇮🇹 Italian
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇰🇷 Korean
🇷🇺 Russian
🇹🇷 Turkish
🇬🇷 Greek
🇬🇪 Georgian

We’re also thrilled to announce that Doctor Life Simulator now features full Turkish voice-over! 🎙️🇹🇷

To ensure everything is polished and localized properly for all players, we’ve made the decision to move the Early Access release date to May 30, 2025.

We know delays are never easy, but we believe this short wait will help us deliver a better and more inclusive experience for everyone. Thank you for your support and patience!

See you soon in the hospital corridors!
[url=https://discord.gg/7PKAh5g779]Discord[/url]

notes.title: 🩺 Doctor Life Simulator – Live Stream at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
🩺 Doctor Life Simulator – Live Stream at Steam Next Fest!

🚨 Join us for an exclusive live stream during Steam Next Fest! 🚨

We’re thrilled to announce that Doctor Life Simulator, developed by Bleeding Edge Studios and published by Blackburne Games Studio FZ LLC & Indienext, will be featured in Steam Next Fest from February 24 to March 1! 🎉

To celebrate, we’ll be hosting live streams throughout the event to showcase the game in action, answer your questions, and interact with our community!

🏥 Medicine is an art—can you master it?
Step into the shoes of a doctor, diagnose patients, manage hospital staff, and make life-changing medical decisions. Experience the thrill and pressure of the medical field in Doctor Life Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/a9457b9e03ecb69711caf62bfed01037dec69eb7.png[/img]

🩸 Development Roadmap 🩸
🚑 v0.1 – Alpha (January 2025): First internal test version.
🩺 v0.5 – Beta (Q1 2025): Feature-complete, refining stage.
💊 v0.7 – Early Access (March 2025): Available for players with early user feedback.
🏥 v1 – Full Release (June 2025): Stable public version.
⚕ v1.1 – Advanced Operations Update: More in-depth medical gameplay!

💡 What Awaits You in the Live Stream & Demo?

🩺 Realistic Patient Diagnosis & Treatment – Identify illnesses and determine the best course of action.
🏥 Hospital Management Mechanics – Balance resources, staff schedules, and medical priorities.
⚖ Ethical Dilemmas & Difficult Choices – Sometimes, saving a life isn’t as simple as it seems.
🚨 Emergencies & Unexpected Cases – Think fast and make the right call under pressure!

🎮 Join the live stream & play the FREE demo now to put your medical skills to the test!

🚨 Don’t Miss Out!

📌 Live streams happening throughout Steam Next Fest (February 24 - March 1)—stay tuned!
📌 Join our Discord for exclusive events and updates!
📌 Follow our social media channels for the latest news!
📌 Wishlist & follow the game to stay up to date with all updates!
